시편-28-1.title: 시편 28장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-28-1.exegesis: 14. Wait, &c.-- in confident expectation. The last clause is, literally, "and wait," &c., as if expecting new measures of help.
시편-28-1.theologicalNote: 14. Wait, &c.-- in confident expectation. The last clause is, literally, "and wait," &c., as if expecting new measures of help.

시편-28-2.title: 시편 28장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-28-2.exegesis: PSALM 28 Psa 28:1-9 . An earnest cry for divine aid against his enemies, as being also those of God, is followed by the Psalmist's praise in assurance of a favorable answer, and a prayer for all God's people. 1. my rock-- ( Psa 18:2 , 31 ). be not silent to me-- literally, "from me," deaf or inattentive. become like them, &c.-- share their fate. go down into the pit-- or, "grave" ( Psa 30:3 ).
시편-28-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 28 Psa 28:1-9 . 시편-28-3.title: 시편 28장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-28-3.exegesis: 2. lift up my hands-- a gesture of prayer ( Psa 63:4 ; 141:2 ). oracle-- place of speaking ( Ex 25:22 ; Nu 7:89 ), where God answered His people (compare Psa 5:7 ).

시편-28-4.title: 시편 28장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-28-4.exegesis: 3. Draw me not away-- implies punishment as well as death (compare Psa 26:9 ). Hypocrisy is the special wickedness mentioned.
시편-28-4.theologicalNote: 3. Draw me not away-- implies punishment as well as death (compare Psa 26:9 ). Hypocrisy is the special wickedness mentioned.

시편-28-5.title: 시편 28장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-28-5.exegesis: 4. The imprecation is justified in Psa 28:5 . The force of the passage is greatly enhanced by the accumulation of terms describing their sin. endeavours-- points out their deliberate sinfulness.
시편-28-5.theologicalNote: 4. The imprecation is justified in Psa 28:5 . The force of the passage is greatly enhanced by the accumulation of terms describing their sin. endeavours-- points out their deliberate sinfulness.

시편-28-6.title: 시편 28장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-28-6.exegesis: 5. Disregard of God's judgments brings a righteous punishment. destroy ... build ... up-- The positive strengthened by the negative form.
시편-28-6.theologicalNote: 5. Disregard of God's judgments brings a righteous punishment. destroy ... build ... up-- The positive strengthened by the negative form.

시편-28-8.title: 시편 28장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-28-8.exegesis: 7. The repetition of "heart" denotes his sincerity.
시편-28-8.theologicalNote: 7. The repetition of "heart" denotes his sincerity.

시편-28-9.title: 시편 28장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-28-9.exegesis: 8. The distinction made between the people. their strength-- and the anointed--may indicate Absalom's rebellion as the occasion.
